ktte01.title: Aries Has One Second
ktte01.caption:
Call or text? One second to pick. Aries never hesitates, until the card says sorry first.
Fast at everything. Even apologies.

ktte02.title: Taurus Won't Let Go
ktte02.caption:
Missing someone at 11 p.m. and the phone is right there?
Taurus put the ex card down and texted a friend instead.

ktte03.title: Gemini, Pick One
ktte03.caption:
Can you pick just one? Gemini tried. Twice.
When it counts, the honest answer is the only one you need.

ktte04.title: Left on Read: Spiral or Chill
ktte04.caption:
Left on read. Is your brain already writing the worst ending?
Cancer waited it out and called a friend. Busy is not a verdict.

ktte05.title: Leo, Ask About Them
ktte05.caption:
Big entrance or quiet one? Leo knows. But the real choice came last.
Ask about them. Watch them light up.

ktte06.title: Virgo Made a Pro and Con List
ktte06.caption:
Two options and you made a list with tabs? Same, Virgo.
Perfect can wait. Being there is the part they remember.

ktte07.title: Libra, Your Vote Counts
ktte07.caption:
Do you say whatever you want and mean it less every time?
Libra finally picked what it wanted. Your vote counts too.

ktte08.title: Scorpio, Guess or Ask
ktte08.caption:
They said haha. With a period. Is that bad?
Scorpio stopped decoding and just asked. Faster than guessing.

ktte09.title: Sagittarius Saw 'What Are We?'
ktte09.caption:
Someone asked what are we and you went quiet?
Sagittarius picked freedom every time. Then picked someone to tell it all to.

ktte10.title: Capricorn, Are You Fine?
ktte10.caption:
Say I'm fine, do it alone, repeat. Sound like you?
Capricorn finally said not really, and got a hug. Strong people get those too.

ktte11.title: Aquarius Dodges the Feelings Card
ktte11.caption:
Deep talk or space facts? Aquarius chose facts. Twice.
Then said the feeling anyway. Keep the fun fact, say the feeling.

ktte12.title: Pisces Can't See the Cards
ktte12.caption:
Ever cried at a sunrise and a question at the same time?
Pisces chose to cry with a friend. Feel it, just not alone.

ktte13.title: Aries vs Libra: Where Do We Eat
ktte13.caption:
Where do we eat? Whatever you want. Where do we eat? Whatever you want.
One real answer saves the whole night.

ktte14.title: Taurus vs Scorpio: Who Says It First
ktte14.caption:
Who says I love you first? These two waited five months to find out.
Sometimes you both meant it the whole time.

ktte15.title: Gemini vs Sagittarius: The 2 A.M. Scroll
ktte15.caption:
It's 2 a.m. One more video, or their profile again?
Phone face down. Tomorrow is nicer than the scroll.

ktte16.title: Cancer vs Capricorn: Whose Family for the Holidays
ktte16.caption:
Whose family for the holidays? Both of you said mine.
One talk, one calendar, one day each.

ktte17.title: Leo vs Aquarius: Post Us or Not
ktte17.caption:
Post the couple photo tonight, or keep it just yours?
Leo and Aquarius met in the middle: post the shoes.

ktte18.title: Virgo vs Pisces: Moving On
ktte18.caption:
Delete the photos or keep them in a folder you never open?
There is no right speed for moving on. Only yours.

ktte19.title: The Zodiac Votes: Call or Text
ktte19.caption:
Call or text? Twelve signs ran to opposite sides.
Then a third option showed up and everyone switched teams.

ktte20.title: The Zodiac Votes: Plan or Surprise
ktte20.caption:
Plan the whole date, or surprise me? The zodiac tied.
The winning move: just ask what they'd like.
